svg.title: Cybersecurity Roadmap for Bug Bounty
svg.desc: A phased roadmap from foundations to bug bounty, combining Broadway course with self-study

g.text: Broadway class + daily self-study (1–2 hrs total)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Give me a beginner guide to TCP/IP, DNS and HTTP for cybersecurity')
sendPrompt('Explain Linux CLI commands I need to know for cybersecurity')
sendPrompt('Explain the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities with examples')
sendPrompt('Give me a 15 minute daily cybersecurity study habit plan')
g.text: Daily habit: read 1 OWASP entry + write handwritten notes after every Broadway class

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I set up Burp Suite for web app pentesting as a beginner?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up DVWA locally and what should I practice on it?')
sendPrompt('Give me a PortSwigger Web Security Academy learning path for beginners')
sendPrompt('What TryHackMe rooms should I start with as a beginner in web security?')
g.text: Weekly: 1 TryHackMe room (web-focused) + replay every Broadway lab at home same evening

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are good beginner HackTheBox machines for web app hacking?')
sendPrompt('How do I participate in my first CTF competition? What should I know?')
sendPrompt('How do I write a good pentest report and lab writeup?')
sendPrompt('How do I build a cybersecurity portfolio for bug bounty?')
g.text: Start a writeup blog or GitHub portfolio — document every machine you solve

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I get started on HackerOne as a beginner bug bounty hunter?')
sendPrompt('What is eJPT certification and how do I prepare for it?')
sendPrompt('What are the best bug bounty programs for beginners in 2025?')
sendPrompt('What is OSCP and when should I pursue it for bug bounty?')
g.text: Long-term goal: OSCP — the gold standard. Target 12–18 months from today

svg.text: You already know HTTP, APIs, auth flows, DBs. You just need to flip
your mindset from builder → breaker. That's the only switch.
